item.title: Evidence Architecture 4.0 — what counts as evidence?
item.lead: The main improvement is an explicit separation between source material, verification, inference, and hypothesis.

blocks.text: A product page proves that a supplier offers a feature. It does not prove that every agency uses that feature, that the feature has been activated for a specific account, or that the feature is being used unlawfully. These three levels must be documented separately.

A journalistic undercover report can document operational practices very concretely, but a single agency or one employee is not automatically representative of the entire market. A pattern becomes stronger when multiple independent investigations reveal the same modus operandi.

A legal rule is not proof that a specific actor has violated the rule. The legal analysis must therefore always consist of four steps: applicable norm, factual action, evidence of that action, and causality between the action and the violation of the norm.

Statistical figures only acquire the status of a research finding when the population, sample, measurement method, uncertainty, and reproducibility are known. In the later monographs provided, for example, percentages and correlations appear that are not substantiated by a public dataset or method. This edition therefore treats these figures as unconfirmed source material, not as results of this research.

blocks.label: NEW RULE
blocks.text: No figure from the later 21×21 monographs will be used as an empirical fact unless an independent primary or scientific source supports the method and outcome.
